boundary_correction.normalization: Same stock convention: standardize target-minus-V over ALL elongated rows, including masked rows
boundary_correction.scope: Correct real-row TD-lambda targets only; retain original flags, masks, raw actions/logp, rewards, observations and masked-row targets
boundary_correction.upstream_relation: Isolated boundary correction, not a wholesale backport of upstream connector/normalization changes

heldout.reason: Completed rollout lacks full critic observations (e.g. reused actor-only archive)

heldout.finite_horizon_note: Zero-boundary discounted observed rewards. A truncation/fragment does not establish this as the continuing-task value.
heldout.bootstrap_note: Same boundary V_before for every evaluated critic; not an independent truth estimate.
heldout.off_policy_comparison_note: Observed rewards/returns belong to the generating behavior. A matching checkpoint only matches the critic's own stochastic behavior in a noisy rollout. Deterministic nominal actions differ from the stochastic policy even at the same checkpoint. Cross-critic scores do not establish each critic's own-policy value accuracy.
